name: Mothers Yamazaki — with exactly two named Mothers Yamazaki, Samurai you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance and haste
notes: Memory: project_mothers_yamazaki_legend_rule_clause_then_boost_2026-11-27. The sentence's first clause ("the legend rule doesn't apply to them") is a rule the site does not keep; the +2/+2 after it was dropped while vigilance and haste were read. Each Mothers Yamazaki is a Samurai of yours, so each gets +2/+2 from both: 6/6. The opponent's Samurai and your non-Samurai are untouched.
